FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LegTrans DZ

items.q: Does the platform handle the layout of tables and complex documents?
items.a: Yes. Our model faithfully recognizes and reproduces the structure of original documents, including tables, columns, and lists. You save precious time on formatting.

items.q: Can I export translated documents to Microsoft Word?
items.a: Yes, all your processed documents can be exported in one click to Microsoft Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx) to allow easy final revisions.

items.q: Is the system adapted to Algerian legal terminology?
items.a: Absolutely. LegTrans DZ has been specifically optimized for the Algerian market, with an excellent understanding of legal French, classical Arabic, and local administrative terminology.
Absolutely. All documents are encrypted with high-security standards. The confidentiality of your documents is our absolute priority.

items.q: What happens when I exhaust my free trial quota?
items.a: During your trial, you have 5 documents per day. Once the quota is reached, you can wait for the automatic renewal the next day at midnight, or upgrade to the Pro offer for unlimited access.
Absolutely not. AI is an assistant that automates repetitive tasks (data entry, tables, layout). Your expertise remains essential for final review and legal interpretation.

items.q: What document formats can I process?
items.a: PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF. We support large documents. Even medium-quality scanned documents are processed with very high accuracy.

About.title: About LegTrans DZ
About.missionDesc: LegTrans DZ is the first Algerian technological platform designed specifically to assist official translators and legal professionals. Our mission is to automate time-consuming tasks (typing, formatting, complex character recognition) to allow translators to focus on the essence of their profession: legal expertise and certification.
About.historyTitle: 2. Our Story: An academic and innovative project
About.historyDesc: Born from a shared passion for languages and technology, LegTrans DZ was created under the Ministerial Decree 1275 (One Diploma - One Startup). Designed by Translation and Interpreting students, the platform is the result of academic research aimed at bridging the gap between traditional legal translation and the requirements of the digital age.
About.sovereigntyDesc: We firmly believe in digital sovereignty. That is why our Artificial Intelligence is specifically developed and trained on the Algerian context, relying particularly on the official terminology of the Official Journal of the Algerian Republic. We thus offer unparalleled accuracy and perfect adaptation to the realities of local law.
About.glossaryTitle: 4. The Collaborative Glossary: By and for translators
About.glossaryDesc: Because technology does not replace human expertise, we have integrated a collaborative glossary system. Each translator can propose, correct, and validate legal terms. Together, we are building the largest legal translation memory in Algeria, validated by the collective intelligence of the profession.
About.legalDesc: As an officially registered Startup project, we place the protection of your data at the center of our priorities. LegTrans DZ is committed to strictly respecting the regulations in force (notably Law 18-07 on data protection), thus guaranteeing absolute confidentiality for you and your clients.
